title: VINDKAST pendant lamp
description: VINDKAST pendant lamp, white, 20" Like a white fluffy cloud of recycled polyester, the sewn shade of this pendant lamp creates a nice atmosphere with its soft glow. Perfect for hanging in the bedroom or over the coffee table. Gives a soft mood light.
features: Light bulb sold separately. recommends LED bulb E26 globe opal white.
Use an opal light bulb if you have an ordinary lamp shade or lamp and want an even, diffused distribution of light.
If you choose a smart light bulb for your lamp, you can change the color and dim the light.
To be hung on a ceiling hook and attached with screws.
materialAndCare: Shade: 100 % polyester (100% recycled), 49-51 % Polyurethane; Shade ring: Steel, Powder coating; Zipper: 100 % polyester
